1.explanation: Each of the skeleton components above renders an empty <label> (for example, TextAreaSkeleton does `<label htmlFor={id} className="bx--label bx--skeleton" />` with no inner text). Running DAP (or axe) against this markup will raise the rule “Provide descriptive text in LABEL elements” because the label is present but contains no human-readable text to identify the control. The reproduce code simply mounts all skeleton variants in a React app so you can inspect the DOM and confirm the empty-label accessibility violation.
1.bug_scenario: When rendering the skeleton states for form controls (CheckboxSkeleton, NumberInputSkeleton, SelectSkeleton, SliderSkeleton, TextAreaSkeleton, TextInputSkeleton), each skeleton component outputs a <label> element with no inner text. DAP flags this as “Provide descriptive text in LABEL elements” because the <label> is empty and does not identify the associated control.
